name: Tools

pages.title: Tools
pages.text: There are two tool items provided to help Nation owners place Zone and Citizen Parcels:$(br2)$(li)Zone Placement Tool$(li)Citizen Placement Tool$(br2)Both work is a similar fashion. Placement Tools can only be used within a Nation, by a Nation owner.

pages: Using the tool the first time will place a Zone or Citizen Placement block into the World. Using the tool a second time at a different location will place another Placement block and generate the borders between the two blocks.$(br)This is the boundaries of the Parcel. Using the tool on either of the Placement blocks will create a new Parcel, and the blocks and border will be removed.
